title: Tesla's Optimus will be 'its biggest product ever'

summary: Laffer Tengler Investments CEO and CIO Nancy Tengler sits down with Brooke DiPalma to expand upon her outlook on Tesla (TSLA), especially as the EV company expands its vision further into autonomous driving and robotics.

title: Hyperscaler results pose major test for AI-driven US stock market
title_zh: 超大规模的结果对人工智能驱动的美国股市构成重大考验
summary: A pivotal moment for the artificial intelligence trade driving the U.S. stock market to all-time highs arrives on Wednesday with quarterly reports from four massive companies at the heart of the investment boom behind the new technology.
summary_zh: 周三，人工智能交易的关键时刻到来，推动美国股市创下历史新高，四家大型公司发布了季度报告，这些公司是新技术背后投资热潮的核心。

title: US Has More Natural Gas Than It Can Use as War Chokes Global Supply
title_zh: 由于战争阻碍了全球供应，美国的天然气数量超出了其使用量
summary: (Bloomberg) -- As the Iran war strangles natural gas supplies, countries across Asia and Africa are rationing fuel and enduring blackouts.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——由于伊朗战争扼杀了天然气供应，亚洲和非洲国家正在实行燃料配给并持续停电。

title: Market mayhem? Powell's last stand, Big Tech earnings in focus
title_zh: 市场混乱？鲍威尔的最后立场，大型科技公司的盈利成为焦点
summary: A massive week on Wall Street has traders at the edge of their seats. Jerome Powell takes center stage at what will likely be his last post-policy decision press conference as Fed Chair.
summary_zh: 华尔街重要的一周让交易员们坐立不安。杰罗姆·鲍威尔（Jerome Powell）成为焦点，这可能是他作为美联储主席的最后一次政策决定后新闻发布会。

title: Trump’s $1.5 Trillion Defense Plan Draws Rare Republican Pushback
title_zh: 特朗普 1.5 万亿美元的国防计划罕见地遭到共和党的抵制
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Key congressional Republicans are poised to break with Donald Trump on his proposed 44% raise for the Pentagon, a rare act of defiance that signals the president’s weakening grip on Washington as the midterm elections near and he quickly approaches the back half...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——国会主要共和党人准备与唐纳德·特朗普就五角大楼加薪 44% 的提议决裂，这是一种罕见的挑衅行为，表明随着中期选举临近，总统对华盛顿的控制力正在减弱，而且他很快就接近后半段了……

title: China Suspends Autonomous Driving Permits After Baidu Outage
title_zh: 百度宕机后中国暂停自动驾驶许可
summary: (Bloomberg) -- China has suspended issuing new licenses for autonomous vehicles, according to people familiar with the matter, after dozens of Baidu Inc.’s Apollo Go robotaxis suddenly stopped in Wuhan last month, stranding passengers and disrupting traffic.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——据知情人士透露，上个月，数十辆百度公司的 Apollo Go 机器人出租车突然在武汉停下，导致乘客滞留并扰乱交通，中国已暂停发放新的自动驾驶汽车牌照。

summary_zh: （彭博社）——寻找未来几周股市走势线索的投资者将在周三交易结束后立即获得快速解读。彭博社的大多数报道阿联酋退出欧佩克，因为战争颠覆了石油市场，海湾紧张局势加剧。

title: Stock market today: S&P 500, Nasdaq, Dow futures inch up ahead of Mag 7 earnings, last Powell term meeting
title_zh: 今日股市：标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克指数、道琼斯指数期货在鲍威尔上次任期会议上的 Mag 7 财报之前小幅上涨
summary: Attention begins to return to domestic news, whilen Powell's final meeting and Mag 7 earnings hold focus.
summary_zh: 人们的注意力开始回到国内新闻，而鲍威尔的最后一次会议和 Mag 7 财报成为焦点。
